thread:
Sam: Heads-up — I spotted entries in the prefetch ledger with encrypted payloads whose cache keys look like they were derived without tenant-salt. Hit-rate on prefix cache dropped after the encryption change. Anyone else see this?

Alex: Which change? the KV encryption switch last week?

Sam: Yeah. After we turned on per-customer KMS + encrypt-on-write. Quick grep of ledger (example): ``curl -s https://kv.internal/ledger/sha1/abcd1234 | jq .meta`` -> shows "tenant_id": "tenant-42" but key hash = "pref-xyz-no-salt". Not matching our salted-hash format.

Maria: hmm, paste of sample logs:
```
[2026-03-05T14:21:03Z] prefetch: key=pre_0a1b... tenant=tenant-42 encrypted=true salt=""
[2026-03-05T14:21:04Z] prefetch: compute_key(salt=) -> "pre_0a1b..."
```

Jen: Could be an old background job that writes un-salted keys. Did we roll the prefetcher with the new lib?

Sam: Profiling: before change prefix hit-rate 78% overall; after change 52% and ~12% of misses look like same prompt across tenants (collision suspects). Batching and kernel selection might subtly alter the prompt normalization (seq len padding?), see snippet:
```
normalize_prompt(prompt, trim=true, add_metadata=false)
```

Alex: If kernel selection changes tokenization boundaries (e.g., fused kernels adding special tokens), that could change normalized strings -> different keys.

cache-bot: system: ledger-scan completed: 125 entries with salt="" found in shard-3 since 2026-03-05.

Maria: Two paths: (1) backfill salted keys for those entries (rehash+reindex) or (2) expire and let prefetch rebuild with salted keys. Backfill might break decryption unless we keep same cipher.

Sam: Backfill plan: decrypt with old KMS key (we rotated) — risky. Suggest we quarantine affected tenant buckets and force rewarm. Proposed action: add runtime guard: reject writes with empty-salt and log + metric; enqueue background repair job.

Jen: Also add key fingerprint that excludes ephemeral runtime fields (kernel_id, batching_hint) — fingerprint(prompt, tenant_id) -> stable ID.

Alex: +1. Also make a quick hotfix to prefetcher to include tenant-salt at write-time even if upstream didn't provide.

Sam: I'll open a quick PR and patch the running job. Can someone own the audit for affected tenants? We need to notify security/compliance.

Maria: I'll take audit and paging. I'll run a limited rewarm for tenant-42 and monitor hit-rate delta.

Sam: Cool. Action items:
- Sam: PR to add guard + hotfix
- Alex: roll prefetcher binary patch to canary (shard-3)
- Maria: audit & rewarm for affected tenants
- Jen: design stable fingerprint change and ensure kernel selection doesn't leak runtime state into keys

Jen: Can we add unit tests asserting that normalize + fingerprint are invariant to kernel selection? i.e., same prompt + options -> same key.

Sam: Yep. Plan to ship fixes today EOD. If anyone finds other shards with empty-salt grep: ``kv-cli ledger scan --since=2026-03-01 | grep 'salt=""'``

Alex: :thumbsup:
